theater: 米納斯吉拉斯、聖保羅與巴伊亞

battle.name: 巴西獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 米納斯吉拉斯、聖保羅與巴伊亞
battle.brief: 一八二一年葡軍在巴西縮編登船，摩擦累積，一八二二年米納斯、聖保羅、馬拉尼昂相繼起義；九月七日佩德羅在伊皮蘭加宣布獨立，翌年熱尼帕波與巴伊亞兩戰把葡軍逐出最後據點，葡萄牙最後以金錢換承認。卡面這件長槍是方陣的最後一環：它守在第一排，後面才是火槍。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 交戰的一方是葡萄牙王國——一八一五年後的正式國號是「葡萄牙、巴西與阿爾加維聯合王國」——但真正發號施令的是遠在歐洲的里斯本內閣，殖民部以海軍暨海外事務大臣若阿金·沙維耶爾·庫拉多為核心，透過里約的總督府與各省總督（capitães-generais）向巴西的駐軍下令；一八一九年約翰六世返回歐洲之後，里斯本對南美的統治只剩下船艦與幾千名軍人，這種遙距離的宗主權正是起義的燃料。另一方是巴西的武裝起義者：一八二一年起由攝政佩德羅·德·阿爾坎塔拉主持大局，內閣由若澤·博尼法西奧·德·安德拉達·伊席爾瓦把持，中樞在里約；米納斯、聖保羅、馬拉尼昂、阿拉戈斯、伯南布哥（巴伊亞）、塞阿拉內陸的義勇兵與本地常備兵相繼起義，北方由路易斯·阿爾維斯·德·利馬（人稱「父親」）與若澤·若阿基姆·德·阿塞維多率領，聖保羅由馬蒂亞斯·德·奧利維拉·梅內西亞斯與若昂·卡洛斯·德·梅迪塞維斯·德·阿布雷烏率領，伯南布哥由卡爾代拉·布蘭特侯爵與卡伊魯子爵主持，亞馬遜與帕拉一線則由當地議會與民兵策應。葡方的骨幹是一支精銳的本土常備軍：步兵以葡屬的「線列團」（Regimento de Linha）為主幹，配一八一五年式燧發滑膛槍與刺刀，炮兵有輕型野炮與攻城炮，另有隨王室渡海歸來的「法國營」老兵，人數不少而裝備與士氣不一；常備軍多數仍效忠葡王，起義的號召反而在遣散的退伍軍人與地方民兵之間傳開。第三方並非旁觀：拉普拉塔河兩岸的普拉特河聯邦（一八二二年成立）向葡屬南里約格蘭德與西普拉塔擴張，迫使葡軍分兵；英國的商船與資本集中在巴西的金礦、咖啡與棉花貿易上，因而在海上對交戰雙方都保持距離；西屬美洲的獨立國家雖同樣反對葡王，卻未必樂見一個強大的巴西在南方崛起。
countriesEn: One party was the Kingdom of Portugal — formally, from 1815, the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves — but the power actually giving the orders sat in Lisbon, where the colonial department was centred on the secretary of state for the navy and the overseas, Joaquim Xavier Curado, and passed its orders on through the viceroy in Rio and the provincial governors (capitães-generais); after João VI sailed back to Europe in 1819, Lisbon's hold on South America rested on ships and a few thousand soldiers, and that act of distance was itself the kindling of the revolt. Against them stood the armed insurgents of Brazil: from 1821 the regency was in the hands of Pedro de Alcântara, with the ministry controlled by José Bonifácio de Andrada e Silva and the centre of government in Rio; the volunteers and local regulars of Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Maranhão, Alagoas, Pernambuco (Bahia), the sertanejo bands of the Ceará interior and the coastal towns rose in turn, the north being led by Luís Alves de Lima, known as the Father, and by José Joaquim de Azevedo, São Paulo by Matias de Oliveira Messias and João Carlos de Medeiros de Abreu, Pernambuco by the Marquis of Caravelas, Felisberto Caldeira Brant, and the Viscount of Cairu, José Inácio de Lima e Silva, while Pará and the Amazon were answered by the local councils and militia. The backbone of the Portuguese force was a disciplined native army: its infantry rested on the colonial line regiment (Regimento de Linha), armed with the Model 1815 flintlock musket and bayonet, its artillery with light field pieces and siege guns, and behind them the veterans of the French war in the Légion Pacquet, a body numerous but uneven in equipment and in morale; the regulars were mostly still loyal to the Portuguese crown, and the cry that rallied men came instead from the discharged veterans and from the provincial militia. The third parties were not idle: the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, founded in 1822, pushed towards Portuguese Rio Grande and Cisplatina and forced the Portuguese to divide their forces; British shipping and British capital lay in the gold, coffee and cotton trade, so Britain kept its distance at sea from both parties; and the Spanish-American republics, hostile to the Portuguese king, were not necessarily glad to see a powerful Brazil rising in the south.
people: 全軍的主帥是佩德羅·德·阿爾坎塔拉，一八二一年至一八二二年任巴西攝政王；他在一八二一年的「王子巡行」中走遍米納斯與聖保羅，聽到地主與商人對葡萄牙人壟斷官職的怨言，返抵里約後召集制憲議會，於一八二二年九月七日在聖保羅的伊皮蘭加小教堂前宣布獨立，十月十二日在里約的桑塔納廣場宣布加冕，年底完成加冕禮。他身邊最關鍵的人是若澤·博尼法西奧·德·安德拉達·伊席爾瓦：這位後世稱為「巴西國父」的博物學家兼政治家替佩德羅起草宣言，主張廢除奴隸制、取消天主教會的特權，後來在一八二四年憲法的教會條款與奴隸制條款上與佩德羅分歧，一八二四年一月的內閣危機幾乎拆散新政體，他辭去大臣之職退回聖保羅。北線的實際戰將是路易斯·阿爾維斯·德·利馬，人稱「父親」，他率第二、第三「王子志願兵營」自巴伊亞北上，一八二三年三月十三日在熱尼帕波以縱隊與散兵線擊敗葡軍若昂·若澤·達·庫尼亞·菲迪耶的縱隊，一役而全國知名，後升至元帥，其子即後來的卡希亞斯公爵。聖保羅方面是馬蒂亞斯·德·奧利維拉·梅內西亞斯與若昂·卡洛斯·德·梅迪塞維斯·德·阿布雷烏，前者主持城內接管，後者率民兵佔領聖保羅市區與坎普斯。巴伊亞的領袖是卡爾代拉·布蘭特侯爵與卡伊魯子爵，兩人都曾在北線前線服役，主持城防與內陸遊擊；城中最出名的指揮官是弗朗西斯科·薩比諾·阿爾瓦雷斯·達·羅沙，他率領的「鸚鵡營」（Batalhão dos Periquitos）是國民警衛隊的精銳，一八二三年七月二日葡軍登船離去時，正是他從聖馬塞洛堡鳴放最後一響禮炮。巴伊亞共和派另有方濟各會修士費雷·卡內卡等人，州議會於一八二三年七月宣布共和，他則於一八二四年被處決。葡方北線指揮官是菲迪耶，巴伊亞的最後總督兼總指揮是弗朗西斯科·德·薩·梅內塞斯，最後率艦隊離境的是曼努埃爾·德·波特加爾·伊·卡斯特羅。還有兩位非軍事人物決定外部條件：英國外交大臣坎寧在倫敦操作承認的節奏與對葡賠款談判；美國總統門羅於一八二三年提出門羅主義，把美洲新國家視為歐洲舊殖民體系的反面，美國一八二四年正式承認巴西，等於替巴西解除了外交孤立。
peopleEn: The commander of the whole was Pedro de Alcântara, regent of Brazil from 1821 to 1822; on his famous tour of the interior in 1821 he passed through Minas Gerais and São Paulo and heard landowners and merchants voice their grievance against the Portuguese monopoly of office, and back in Rio he summoned the Constituent Assembly, declared independence on 7 September 1822 before the little chapel at Ipiranga in São Paulo, proclaimed himself emperor at the Campo de Santana in Rio on 12 October and was crowned before the year closed. The man closest to him was José Bonifácio de Andrada e Silva: the naturalist and statesman later called the father of Brazil drafted the declaration for Pedro, argued for the abolition of slavery and the end of the Church's privileges, and was then divided from Pedro over the church and slavery clauses of the 1824 constitution; the cabinet crisis of January 1824 nearly broke the new order, and Bonifácio resigned and withdrew to São Paulo. The real field commander in the north was Luís Alves de Lima, called the Father, who led the second and third battalions of the Prince's Volunteers north from Bahia and on 13 March 1823 broke the column of Cunha Fidié at Jenipapo with a mixture of column and skirmish line, becoming known throughout the country in a single day; he rose to marshal, and his son was the future Duke of Caxias. In São Paulo the leaders were Matias de Oliveira Messias, who organised the taking of the city, and João Carlos de Medeiros de Abreu, who brought the militia into São Paulo and into the Campos. The leaders of Pernambuco were the Marquis of Caravelas and the Viscount of Cairu, both of whom had served on the northern front and who directed the defence of the town and the guerrilla war in the interior; the best known commander inside the town was Francisco Sabino Álvares da Rocha, whose Batalhão dos Periquitos, a pick of the National Guard, fired the last salute from the fort of São Marcelo as the Portuguese embarked on 2 July 1823. The republican side in Bahia had others, among them the Franciscan friar Frei Caneca; the provincial assembly proclaimed a republic in July 1823, and he was executed in 1824. On the Portuguese side the commander in the north was Fidié, the last governor and commander in Bahia was Francisco de Sá Meneses, and the officer who took the fleet away at the end was Manuel de Portugal e Castro. Two non-military men shaped the external conditions: the British foreign secretary Canning worked the timing of recognition in London and the indemnity talks with Portugal; and President Monroe's Monroe Doctrine of 1823 set the new American states against Europe's old colonial system, and the formal American recognition of Brazil in 1824 released Brazil from its diplomatic isolation.
kits: 卡面這件長槍是一件一六〇〇年前後的西班牙式長槍，槍身約四公尺，木柄削成多邊形，槍葉狹長。它在一八二二年的巴西早已不是野戰兵器：歐洲的火槍自十六世紀末便把方陣裡的長矛手擠到第一排，十八世紀的線列步兵除了刺刀再無長槍。這件武器在巴西的意義是制度性的——葡屬巴西的步兵團長期沿用「長矛縱隊—縱隊—方陣」的操典與編制，方陣第一排仍由持矛衛兵擔任，長矛科目直到一八〇九年的《步兵士兵手冊》裏仍未刪除；一八二二年起義之後，國民警衛隊與各省義勇兵在儀仗、守衛與街壘上仍配短矛，熱尼帕波一役的志願兵營中，連挑夫都自備削尖的長矛。真正決定戰役的是別的裝備：步兵用一八一五年式燧發滑膛槍，口徑約十七毫米，配通用刺刀；炮兵有四磅、六磅短身野炮與十二磅攻城炮；騎兵是正規騎兵團與騎兵志願兵。火藥完全仰賴進口硝石與硫磺，本土黑火藥產量不足，志願兵常有數百人共用一支火繩的實情。運輸上，內陸給養靠牛車、騾隊與人力馱載，並沿帕拉伊巴河與聖方濟各河上游的水路轉運；巴伊亞圍城期間葡軍以艦隊封鎖海面，巴西人則以城牆、壕溝與自造的燃燒瓶對付封鎖線。東北民兵還大量使用獵槍、砍刀與叉槍，一八二三年熱尼帕波一役的沙盤上，正式的火槍營與土製長矛、獵槍雜在一起。
kitsEn: The pike on this card is a Spanish-pattern pike of about 1600, some four metres long, its shaft faceted from wood and its blade long and narrow. By 1822 it was long out of favour as a field weapon in Brazil: since the late sixteenth century the musket had pushed the pikemen back into the first rank of the pike-and-shot formation, and the linear infantry of the eighteenth century kept nothing of the pike but the bayonet. Its importance in Brazil was institutional rather than practical — the colonial infantry regiments kept the drill and the organisation of the pike column, the line and the square, the first rank of the square being held by pike guards, and pike exercises survived in the infantry soldier's manual as late as 1809; after the revolt of 1822 the National Guard and the provincial volunteers still carried short pikes for dress, for guard duty and for the barricades of the streets, and in the volunteer battalion that fought at Jenipapo even the camp followers had sharpened spears of their own making. What really decided the campaign was other equipment: infantry carried the Model 1815 flintlock musket, roughly seventeen millimetres bore, with the universal bayonet; artillery had four- and six-pounder short field pieces and twelve-pounder siege guns; the horse came from the regular cavalry regiments and the mounted volunteers. Powder was wholly dependent on imported saltpetre and sulphur, home production of black powder being short, and volunteers were often found sharing a single slow match between several hundred men. On the move, food and ammunition travelled on ox-carts, mule trains and human pack, and were shifted by water up the Paraíba and the upper São Francisco; during the siege of Bahia the Portuguese closed the sea with their fleet, and the Brazilians answered the blockade with walls, ditches and improvised fire bottles. The militia of the north-east also used fowling pieces, billhooks and fork-spears in quantity, so that at Jenipapo a proper musket battalion fought shoulder to shoulder with home-made spears and hunting guns.
tactics: 巴西起義的戰術是省級的鬆散圍困與襲擊，不是正面會戰。一八二二年三月六日米納斯起義在奧羅普雷圖爆發，起義者封鎖城門、切斷通往聖保羅的道路、襲擊郊區莊園與運金車隊，七日內總督在聖若澤-德爾雷伊被扣，數週之內整個米納斯落入義勇兵手中；聖保羅義軍在七月攻破城防，馬蒂亞斯·德·奧利維拉·梅內西亞斯接管市政。北方各州則以圍城為主：馬拉尼昂首府聖路易斯在一八二三年被圍數月，守軍屢次出城反擊，圍城方靠遊擊與切斷糧道，最終迫使葡軍放棄。熱尼帕波一役最能說明雙方差異：葡軍以標準縱隊沿河谷行進，縱隊拉得過長，先頭營與後隊脫節；巴西志願兵先把營安插在樹林與高地，等葡縱隊進入河谷彎道，再以小隊散兵線自側面掠射，同時讓炮兵在後方對準狹窄通道，葡縱隊被切成數段，首尾不能相救，傷亡與被俘都集中在道路兩側。巴伊亞的攻城與反攻城另走一路：葡軍以海軍封鎖海面、以分遣隊封鎖城郊陸路，巴西守軍則以游擊隊反覆襲擊分遣隊與運鹽隊，切斷內陸糧源，葡軍最後在卡舒埃拉與巴拉帕拉索兩役中耗盡，於七月二日登船。季節與地形是決定性因素：內陸雨季令道路泥濘、牛車難行，縱隊速度被拖慢；旱季則讓東北民兵能長久在外作戰。
tacticsEn: The Brazilian revolt fought as a loose provincial encirclement and a war of raids, not as a set-piece battle. The Minas rising broke out at Ouro Preto on 6 March 1822: the insurgents barred the gates, cut the road to São Paulo, raided the country estates and the gold convoys on the outskirts, and within days the governor was in custody at São João del-Rei, while in a few weeks the whole province fell into the hands of the volunteers; in São Paulo the militia broke the defences in July and Matias de Oliveira Messias took over the municipality. In the northern provinces the siege was the ruling form: Maranhão's capital, São Luís, was besieged for months in 1823, its garrison repeatedly sallied out, and the besiegers worked by raid and by cutting the food road until the Portuguese gave way. The battle of Jenipapo shows the difference between the two sides most clearly: the Portuguese marched in a standard column along the river valley, the column drawn out so long that the leading battalion lost touch with the rear; the Brazilian volunteers planted their battalion in the woods and on the high ground, waited for the Portuguese to enter the bend of the valley, then let skirmish parties shoot along the flank while the guns in the rear trained on the narrow track, so that the column was cut into several segments which could not support one another, and the dead and the prisoners piled up on either side of the road. The siege and relief of Bahia followed a different line: the Portuguese shut the sea with their fleet and ringed the land approaches with detached columns, and the Brazilian garrison answered with partisan bands that harried those columns and the salt convoys and cut the inland supply; the Portuguese were worn down at Cachoeira and Barra do Paraguaçu and embarked in July. Season and country were decisive factors: the inland rains turned the roads to mud and stalled the ox-carts and slowed the columns, while the dry season let the north-eastern militia stay out in the field for long stretches.
data: 數字方面，史料多為戰報與使節報告，須逐一核對。葡軍在巴西的駐軍，普遍引用的數字是常備軍約二萬至三萬人（一說三萬人以上），其中里約一帶約八千至一萬，巴伊亞與東北約四五千至六千，另有一八一一年隨王室抵達的「法國營」老兵約八千至一萬二千人，於一八一九至一八二一年間陸續遣散回歐洲；真正能用於作戰的常備軍，遠少於上述總數。起義方的編制人數同樣浮動：米納斯起義者常被記作一萬二千至二萬人，聖保羅義軍約八千至一萬人，但裝備與訓練極差，多數只有獵槍與農具。熱尼帕波一役的分歧最大：葡軍多記一千三百至一千五百人（另說一千六百），配十餘門野炮；巴西第二、第三「王子志願兵營」合計約一千二百人，首線接觸的只有數百人，葡軍死傷多記一千以上，巴西損失約三百至四百人。巴伊亞方面，葡軍撤退前尚有二千至三千人，撤離時隨船帶走約二千人與大部分火炮。財政數字最為具體：一八二四年巴西在倫敦發行以關稅收入為抵押的公債，名義二百五十萬鎊，實收現款各書記載在一百萬至一百六十萬鎊之間，年息六釐；一八二五年《里約熱內盧條約》向葡萄牙支付四十萬鎊黃金，分期清償至一八三一年。一八二四年巴西軍費佔國家開支約八成，財政幾乎全部押在戰事與軍購上。距離上，里約至巴伊亞海路約一千三百海里，陸路超過一千五百公里，米納斯至巴伊亞約八百公里。卡面那件一六〇〇年的長槍沒有可比的數字：它決定的是方陣第一排能站住多少人不至於被火槍射程蓋過，而不是任何一場戰鬥的傷亡數字。
dataEn: The figures come mostly from despatches and consular reports and have to be checked one by one. For the Portuguese troops in Brazil the number usually cited is a regular army of some twenty to thirty thousand men (some say above thirty thousand), of whom roughly eight to ten thousand were around Rio and four to five or six thousand in Bahia and the north-east, besides the veterans of the Légion Pacquet, who came with the royal family in 1811 and numbered some eight to twelve thousand before being discharged to Europe in pieces between 1819 and 1821; the regulars actually available for operations were well below the totals just given. The insurgents' numbers are equally unsteady: the Minas force is commonly put at twelve to twenty thousand men and the São Paulo volunteers at eight to ten thousand, but their training and equipment were poor and most carried only fowling pieces and farm tools. The figures for Jenipapo differ the most: the Portuguese are usually given as thirteen to fifteen hundred (others say sixteen hundred) with a dozen or more field guns; the Brazilian second and third battalions of the Prince's Volunteers together numbered about twelve hundred, of whom only several hundred were in contact at the start, and the Portuguese dead and wounded are recorded at more than a thousand against Brazilian losses of roughly three to four hundred. In Bahia the Portuguese still numbered two to three thousand before they left, and about two thousand men with most of the guns went out with the ships. The financial figures are the most concrete: in 1824 Brazil issued a loan in London secured on the customs revenue, nominally two and a half million pounds, for cash actually received of, according to the accounts, between one and one and a half million pounds, at six per cent; the Treaty of Rio de Janeiro of 1825 provided for the payment of four hundred thousand pounds in gold to Portugal, discharged in instalments up to 1831. In 1824 the army took something like eighty per cent of Brazil's public spending, and the finances were very nearly all pledged to the war and to arms. As for distance: roughly thirteen hundred nautical miles by sea from Rio to Bahia and more than fifteen hundred kilometres by land, and about eight hundred kilometres from Minas to Bahia. The pike of 1600 on the card has no comparable figure: what it decided was how many men could hold the first rank of a square without being out-ranged by muskets, and not the casualty figures of any battle.
cause: 打起上來的原因由遠到近有四層。最遠的一層是十八世紀末以來拉丁美洲的獨立浪潮與葡屬巴西的畸形經濟：巴西的出口集中在金礦、蔗糖、咖啡與棉花，進口與高階官職卻被葡萄牙人壟斷，葡國輸往巴西的商品免稅而巴西對葡進口課重稅，「受寵同盟國」制度使本地商人與地主要求開放。最直接的一層是政治：巴西自一八〇八年成為葡王國的避難地與王位所在，一八一五年升格為王國，約翰六世卻屢次打算把王室與政府搬回里斯本，一八二一年一月的利馬公約更把部分政治權力交回葡國本土，使巴西人普遍相信葡萄牙只把巴西當作財源與兵源的來源。一八二一年起葡軍在里約與各省縮編、被指派回國，退役老兵與本地常備兵遭裁撤，摩擦公開化，米納斯與聖保羅的礦區與咖啡莊園隨即成為火種；營房之間的不滿與報紙、咖啡館裡對君主制的共和論辯，把火種變成計畫。內在的一層是舊記憶：一七八九年米納斯的「白土密謀」與一八一七年伯南布哥共和政府的流亡，把共和與獨立的方案帶回巴西。最後一層是國際環境：拉普拉塔河聯邦獨立並向東推進，直接威脅葡國在南美的最後據點；英國與美國先後表示歡迎美洲新國家，葡國在里約熱內盧與巴黎的遊說便失去了從前的份量。
causeEn: There were four layers behind the fighting, from the remotest to the nearest. The farthest is the wave of Latin American independence since the late eighteenth century and the lopsided economy of colonial Brazil: Brazilian exports were concentrated in gold, sugar, coffee and cotton, while the imports and the higher offices were held by the Portuguese; Portuguese goods entered Brazil duty-free while Brazil paid heavy duties on Portuguese imports, and this favoured-alliance system made local merchants and landowners demand an opening. The most immediate layer is political. Brazil was the refuge and the seat of the Portuguese crown from 1808 and was raised to a kingdom in 1815, yet João VI more than once spoke of moving the court and the government back to Lisbon, and the Lima Convention of January 1821 handed part of the political power back to metropolitan Portugal, so that Brazilians came broadly to believe that Portugal treated Brazil only as a source of revenue and of soldiers. From 1821 the Portuguese garrison in Rio and in the provinces was cut back and ordered home, discharged veterans and local regulars were dismissed, and the friction became public; the mining districts and the coffee plantations of Minas and São Paulo were the fuse, and the disaffection in the barracks and the republican argument in the newspapers and coffee-houses turned the fuse into a plan. One layer is older memory: the Inconfidência Mineira of 1789 and the exiled government of Pernambuco in 1817 carried the republican and separatist idea back into Brazil. The last layer is the international situation: the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata, newly independent and pushing east, threatened the last Portuguese positions in the south, while Britain and the United States both welcomed the new American states, and the lobbying of Portugal in Rio and in Paris lost its former weight.
impact: 戰爭的直接產物是巴西帝國：一八二二年十月佩德羅加冕，一八二四年三月二十五日憲法頒布，確立皇帝、兩院議會與各省自治的架構，巴西由此成為當時美洲最大的國家之一，與同時期的美國門羅主義隔海相呼應。留下的問題更重：奴隸制在憲法中保留，解放與廢奴的運動從此在帝國境內持續存在；黑人士兵營、解放黑人的民兵以及天主教會的特權爭議，成為一八二四年內閣危機的焦點，博尼法西奧去職正是因為他不接受保留奴隸與教會特權的條款。財政上，巴西靠倫敦借債度過戰後，關稅收入一度抵押給外債，直到一八三〇年代才重新取得自理的財政能力，軍費常年佔開支八成，又反過來推高稅負。對外關係上，葡萄牙以四十萬鎊換取承認，等於承認了葡屬巴西的現有疆界；巴西隨即轉向歐洲購買軍艦並建構海軍，一八二五年「獨立號」下水，拉丁美洲第一支近代海軍由此起步。戰爭也加速了南方的斷裂：一八二五年起巴西與普拉特河聯邦為西普拉塔作戰，一八二八年《蒙得維的亞條約》把西普拉塔交給烏拉圭，帝國的南部邊界就此固定，巴西放棄了把拉普拉塔納入版圖的主張；與此同時，西屬美洲的獨立國家也看清了一個強大的巴西既可為盟友，亦可能是南方最大的競爭者。
impactEn: The direct product of the war was the Empire of Brazil: Pedro was crowned in October 1822, and the constitution of 25 March 1824 set up the emperor, a two-chamber parliament and provincial autonomy, so that Brazil became one of the largest states in the Americas and answered the Monroe Doctrine of the same years across the Atlantic. The unresolved questions were heavier. Slavery was kept in the constitution, and the movements for manumission and abolition ran on inside the empire from then on; the Black battalions, the militia of free Blacks and the dispute over the Church's privileges became the flashpoints of the cabinet crisis of 1824, and Bonifácio resigned precisely because he would not accept clauses preserving slavery and Church privilege. Financially, Brazil paid for the war with a London loan and pledged its customs revenue, and did not recover a workable fiscal position until the 1830s, while an army that permanently absorbed some eighty per cent of the budget pushed the tax burden up in turn. In foreign affairs, Portugal's four hundred thousand pounds bought recognition, and with it acceptance of Brazil's existing frontiers; Brazil then turned to Europe to buy warships and build a navy, and the launch of the Independence in 1825 began the first modern navy in Latin America. The war also hastened the split in the south: from 1825 Brazil fought the United Provinces over Cisplatina, and the Treaty of Montevideo of 1828 gave Cisplatina to Uruguay, fixing the empire's southern border and ending any claim to the Río de la Plata; at the same time the Spanish-American republics saw clearly that a powerful Brazil could be an ally and could equally be the greatest rival in the south.
result: 結果是葡萄牙軍隊全面退出：巴伊亞的葡軍在卡舒埃拉與巴拉帕拉索兩役之後，被迫於一八二三年七月二日從聖馬塞洛堡登船，帶走約二千人與大部分火炮；一八二四年，駐里約的最後一批葡萄牙部隊登船回國，葡國在南美的統治就此結束。一八二五年八月二十九日簽訂的《里約熱內盧條約》由葡萄牙正式承認巴西獨立，巴西則以四十萬鎊黃金作為補償，分六期清償、翌年批准；一八二四年美國、一八二六年英國相繼承認，巴西的國際地位在三年內完成。國內方面，地方起義雖被壓下去，軍隊卻留在原地，佩德羅不得不靠外債維持近二十萬的常備軍，而一八二四年憲法與其後對東北地方武裝的清剿之後，帝國的路線轉向做「在歐洲之外的美洲帝國」。就卡面這件長槍而言，可以確定的只有一點：它並未在一八二二至一八二三年的任何一場戰鬥中直接決定勝負——熱尼帕波靠的是地形、散兵線與炮火，巴伊亞靠的是封鎖線被切斷與城防工事；長槍代表的是一條正在退場的血統，當火槍隊退回方陣第二排之後，長矛手就再也沒有回到前線。
resultEn: The result was a complete Portuguese withdrawal: after the actions at Cachoeira and Barra do Paraguaçu, the Portuguese in Bahia embarked from the fort of São Marcelo on 2 July 1823, taking about two thousand men and most of their guns; in 1824 the last Portuguese troops stationed at Rio sailed for home, and Portuguese rule in South America came to an end. The Treaty of Rio de Janeiro, signed on 29 August 1825, was Portugal's formal recognition of Brazilian independence, against a payment of four hundred thousand pounds in gold, settled in six instalments and ratified the following year; the United States recognised Brazil in 1824 and Britain in 1826, and within three years the international position of the new state was complete. At home the local risings were put down, but the army stayed where it was, and Pedro had to keep close to two hundred thousand regulars alive on borrowed money; after the constitution of 1824 and the clearing of the armed bands of the interior that followed, the empire's course turned towards being an American empire outside Europe. As for the pike on this card, only one thing can be said with certainty: it decided no battle in 1822 or 1823 — Jenipapo was won by ground, by skirmish line and by artillery, and Bahia by the cutting of the blockade and by the works of the defence; the pike stands for a line of descent that was on its way out, and once the musketeers were back in the second rank of the square the pikemen never returned to the front.
